title: Largesse
description: Another player adds 1 random Colorless card to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
upgraded_description: Another player adds 1 random [gold]Upgraded[/gold] Colorless card to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
notes: Multiplayer only. This card generates a random Colorless card from the unlocked pool and adds it to another player's hand. If upgraded, the generated card is also upgraded.
